_note: SAMPLE DATA: Pre-event checklist template for destination and multi-ceremony weddings with relative due dates.
name: Indian Destination Wedding Master Checklist

items.title: Lock Venue & Book Guest Room Inventory
items.description: Finalize venue contract, deposit payment schedule, and room blocking for out-of-town guests.

items.title: Catering Tasting & Menu Curation
items.description: Taste test live chaat, regional Mewari specialties, international stations and clarify tax & service charge terms.

items.title: Book Cinematographer & Drone Operators
items.description: Review portfolios, verify high-resolution equipment, drone permits over Lake Pichola, and same-day teaser delivery.

items.title: Mandap 3D Render Signoff & Floral Sourcing
items.description: Approve mandap architectural render, seating layouts, and specify cold storage for exotic florals.

items.title: Bridal Lehenga & Groom Sherwani First Trials
items.description: Complete fittings for all major functions (Mehendi, Sangeet, Pheras, Reception).

items.title: Lock Sangeet Track List & Choreographer Sessions
items.description: Coordinate virtual rehearsal track cuts for family performances and finalize anchor script.

items.title: Finalize Airport Shuttle Manifest & Fleet Allocations
items.description: Match guest flight arrival times to Innova / bus departure slots from Maharana Pratap Airport.

items.title: Sound & Pyrotechnic Local Police / City Permissions
items.description: Secure sound decibel exemption permits for outdoor music past 10 PM and fireworks clearances.

items.title: Final Headcount Guarantee to Caterer
items.description: Confirm locked guest count to avoid minimum pax penalties and adjust buffet buffer allowances.

items.title: Hamper Delivery to Hotel Front Desks
items.description: Assemble welcome luggage tags, itinerary booklets, local sweets, and emergency kit for guest rooms.

items.title: Mandap Puja Samagri & Pandit Coordination
items.description: Hand over items list, ghee, havan wood, coconut, garlands and review ritual muhurat timings.

items.title: Live Day-of Vendor Arrival & Sound Check
items.description: Check generator fuel levels, audio lines, mic battery packs, and green room hospitality.
